settings.disk.title: Storage
settings.disk.kind.runtimes_help: Disks of the Linux computers and the runtimes they need. Mac computers and other virtual machines stay where they are.
settings.disk.kind.cache_help: Icons, thumbnails and install downloads Cua can fetch again. Build outputs and job caches stay where they are.
settings.disk.kind.logs_help: What the Cua daemon writes down for troubleshooting. Some helper logs stay in Library/Logs.

settings.disk.uninstall_body: Cua quits and removes itself from this Mac, with its settings, caches and logs. Your computers, images and recordings stay on this disk, in the folders listed above, unless you remove them first.
settings.disk.uninstall_keychain: Also remove sign-in and keys from the Keychain
